aboutHeading: 15+ Years Cabinet Making in Airport West
aboutText: Airport West Cabinets has been designing and building premium custom cabinetry for homes and businesses across Melbourne's north-west for over 15 years. Based right here in Airport West on Hawker St, we specialise in creating beautiful, functional storage solutions that are built to last. Every piece is crafted locally with attention to detail and a commitment to quality workmanship our customers have come to rely on.
servicesText: From concept to completion, we design and manufacture custom cabinetry tailored to your exact requirements. Our Airport West workshop handles everything from initial consultation through to professional installation.
